description: Compresses data with gzip. Takes text or base64, returns base64 (or text) so the result can go in an API payload, e.g. a bank payment file.
label: Gzip

options.name: data
options.label: Data
options.info: The data to compress: plain text such as XML, or a base64 string such as a file returned by another system. Set Input encoding to match.

options.name: input-encoding
options.label: Input encoding
options.info: UTF-8 text: Data is used as is. Base64: Data is base64-decoded first (standard base64; line breaks are ignored).

options.name: output-encoding
options.label: Output encoding
options.info: Base64: the compressed bytes as a standard, padded base64 string. Gzip output is binary, so UTF-8 text fails for almost any input.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: The compressed data, base64-encoded unless Output encoding says otherwise.
